# tsKaizen

> tsKaizen builds websites, missed-call follow-up and AI assistants for home and mobile service businesses (plumbing, roofing, HVAC, painting, mobile detailing, pressure washing) in Orlando and Palm Beach County, Florida. Founder: Anthony Pichardo. Every project starts with a free working demo of the new home page, delivered within 5 business days.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://tskaizen.com/): what tsKaizen does and the free demo
- [Trades](https://tskaizen.com/trades): one page per trade
- [Pricing](https://tskaizen.com/pricing): fixed website packages, care plans and add-ons
- [Work](https://tskaizen.com/work): client case studies (NextGen Blinds, Wax On Wheels, MyClearDeal)
- [About](https://tskaizen.com/about): who builds the sites
- [Get a quote](https://tskaizen.com/quote)
